bias_caveat: IMPORTANT: Facial emotion recognition (DeepFace) has documented accuracy disparities across skin tone and gender (Buolamwini & Gebru, 2018; Fan et al., 2023). Authenticity scores informed by facial data should be interpreted with this limitation in mind.
vocal_caveat: IMPORTANT: The vocal emotion channel is the second weakest of the four, after facial emotion, and is explicitly down-weighted. Benchmarked on 150 hand-rated clips from 6 speakers (vocal_bench/), the adopted model scores 48.9% three-class accuracy on held-out speakers - better than the model it replaced, which at 34.0% was significantly worse than always guessing NEUTRAL (p = 0.0070), but still not reliably better than that constant. No model tested beat it. Conflicts attributed to the vocal channel alone are damped accordingly, and per-segment claims should not rest on this channel. Read the within-video figure, not the headline: this report compares segments inside one video, and the channel's rank correlation with human judgement measured within a video is +0.159 across 147 clips and +0.056 on unseen speakers (vocal_bench/SPEAKER_NORM_RESULT.md). Most of its apparent accuracy is a between-video effect that says more about the speaker's habitual energy than about any individual moment.
vocal_licence_note: The adopted vocal model (audeering/wav2vec2-large-robust-12-ft-emotion-msp-dim) is licensed CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 and may not be used commercially. Every configuration measured in vocal_bench/ that showed usable signal was non-commercially licensed; the permissively-licensed alternatives measured at the bottom of every table. A commercial deployment would need to ship without this channel or replace it.

all_comments.text: Calling these earbuds the best value in company history before even testing them in your own ears is classic tech hype. When you look at the engineering objectively, claiming a 50 percent improvement in active noise cancellation on an open design is pure marketing fiction. Active noise cancellation relies on precise phase cancellation, which by the laws of acoustic physics requires a sealed acoustic chamber to prevent ambient leakage. Without silicone tips, predictable low frequencies still bypass the housing, while mid and high frequency noise like human speech cannot be attenuated at all. Delivering 4 hours of battery on the 129 dollar base model and 5 hours on the 149 dollar model is frankly disappointing for 2026. Miniature lithium batteries degrade after 300 to 500 charge cycles, so after 18 or 24 months of daily use, your playback time will shrink to barely 2 hours, turning them into disposable electronics. Under the hood there is no technological breakthrough either, as both models reuse the older 2 generation processor instead of bringing a new 3 generation chip. Apple is also aggressively cutting costs by removing the basic charging cable from the box, stripping out ultra wideband chips so you lose precision finding, and gating swipe volume controls behind a 20 dollar upsell. Any perceived fullness in sound is just digital signal processing boosting frequencies below 100 hertz, which quickly produces audible distortion at 75 percent volume because open earbuds fundamentally lack sub bass pressure. Praising a 129 dollar refresh with recycled silicon, mediocre battery endurance, and compromised acoustic physics as an unbeatable bargain completely misses the reality of hardware longevity.
